name: Drooping Brome
desc: Drooping Brome (Bromus tectorum): a plant that turns sunlight into food. Recorded 3 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Bromus tectorum, known as downy brome, drooping brome, or cheatgrass, is a winter annual grass native to Europe, southwestern Asia, and northern Africa, but has become invasive in many other areas.
